source.title: Audio source
source.chooseApp: Choose an app to listen to
source.appHint: Android 10+: captures the selected app's audio directly. Some apps block capture — use Microphone then.
source.iosHint: iOS captures all system audio via screen broadcast, Cloud only.

engine.title: Mode
engine.offlineNotReady: Download a speech model and the EN/VI packs to use Offline.

home.subtitle: Realtime English ⇄ Vietnamese subtitles
home.overlayHint: Show subtitles over other apps (YouTube, Zoom…)

overlay.title: Floating subtitles
overlay.dragHint: Drag the subtitle box to move it
overlay.sampleOriginal: Let me show you a quick demo.
overlay.sampleTranslated: Để tôi cho bạn xem một bản demo nhanh.
overlay.nativeNote: Dragging directly over other apps arrives in phase 3.

history.title: History
history.emptyHint: Finished translation sessions show up here.
history.deleteMessage: All of its content will be removed from this device.

packs.title: Language packs
packs.wifiOnlyNote: Downloads only on Wi-Fi (change in Settings).

model.small: More accurate, needs a fast device

settings.title: Settings
settings.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted on this device, only sent to the provider.
settings.silenceHint: Shorter → faster translation, but sentences get cut more often.

debug.title: Latency debug
debug.empty: No data yet. Run a translation session.
debug.note: Measured from the chunk's first word → chunk cut → translation ready. Audio capture time is added in phase 2.

onboarding.welcomeBody: Listen to speech and get English ⇄ Vietnamese subtitles almost instantly, even over other apps.
onboarding.chooseDirection: Which way do you want to translate?
onboarding.cloudDesc: Fastest and most accurate (~1s). Needs Internet and a provider API key.
onboarding.offlineDesc: Runs fully on-device (~2–3s). Requires downloading models first.
onboarding.apiKeyLater: You can enter the API key later in Settings.
onboarding.micBody: Microphone: to hear speech around you or from the speaker.
onboarding.overlayBody: Display over other apps (Android): asked when you first enable floating subtitles.
onboarding.micNote: The microphone prompt appears when you start your first session.
